New Property Transfer Rules in Delhi

The government of Delhi has introduced new rules for property transfer, requiring stamp duty payment and registration with the sub-registrar. The move aims to prevent stamp duty evasion. The rules apply to all transactions involving the Generalised Programme of Assistance (GPA) in Delhi.
